content.commitment: to launch a joint attack on French positions in MAR and BRE, diverting their forces and securing our shared borders

content.message: Monsieur le Chancelier, the balance of Europe demands prudence. Let us avoid mutual entanglements in the east while securing our western flanks. A non-aggression pact would preserve our respective interests.
content.commitment: France will not interfere with Germany's operations in the east, provided Germany respects French supply lines in the west.

content.message: Monsieur le Chancelier, I accept your non-aggression proposal. In return, Germany will safeguard France's western supply lines and refrain from offensive actions against French territories. Let us consolidate our strategic interests and ensure mutual prosperity.
content.commitment: Germany will not attack French supply centers in the west and will defend French territory against third-party aggression.

content.message: Monsieur le Chancelier, our pact ensures mutual respect for supply lines. Let us formalise this with a mutual defense clause: should third parties threaten either of our realms, we shall stand as one. This fortifies our strategic interests and preserves the balance of Europe.
content.commitment: France will defend Germany against third-party aggression, and Germany will defend France against third-party aggression.

content.message: Monsieur le Chancelier, I accept the mutual defense clause. Germany will stand by France's side in any conflict, ensuring our western flank remains secure. Let us formalize this alliance to strengthen our positions in Europe.
content.commitment: Germany will defend France's western territories and supply lines against any aggressor.

content.message: Monsieur le Chancelier, our alliance is now formalized. France reaffirms its commitment to defend Germany's eastern territories alongside its western obligations. Together, we shall preserve the equilibrium of Europe.
content.commitment: France will defend Germany's eastern territories against third-party aggression, in addition to its western commitments.

content.message: Monsieur le Chancelier, our alliance's strength lies in unity. With Russia's ambitions eastward and Austria's restless gaze westward, let us coordinate our forces to deter aggression. Germany proposes joint operations to secure the Rhine and ensure uninterrupted supply lines to your western territories.
content.commitment: Germany will provide military support to France's western front in case of Russian or Austrian aggression.
